subject: Skyline Health — compliance architecture deep-dive & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <j.torres@skylinehealth.com>, Micah Patel <m.patel@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Skyline Health — compliance architecture deep-dive & evidence timeline

Hi Jamie / Micah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to walk through:

- Redwood inference architecture for customer isolation (Dedicated vs. Private)
- SOC 2 artifact mapping (where logs, keys, config live)
- SSO integration approach and required test accounts (SAML/OIDC)
- Encryption at rest/key management and audit log retention options

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 10/05 10:30–11:30
- Wed 10/06 09:00–10:00
- Wed 10/06 15:00–16:00

If none of those work, tell us which day/time window you prefer and we’ll reshuffle. We anticipate 60–90 minutes depending on how many artifacts you want to review.

I’ll include a short evidence inventory template and our architecture diagram for prep. Please confirm who from your side will attend (security engineer + cloud infra preferred).

Thanks,

— Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_arch_diagram.png]

From: Jamie Torres <j.torres@skylinehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Micah Patel <m.patel@skylinehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Skyline Health — compliance architecture deep-dive & evidence timeline

Thanks Lauren —

All good to move forward. We prefer splitting into two focused sessions: 1) Architecture + SSO (60 min) and 2) SOC 2 evidence walkthrough (45 min). That helps get the right folks in for each segment.

Current availability (PST):
- Tue 10/05 10:30–11:30 (works for architecture)
- Wed 10/06 15:00–16:00 (better for evidence review)

Attendees: Jamie Torres (security PM), Micah Patel (cloud eng). I’ll check with our security engineer (likely Chris Bell) and confirm.

Also: can you share the evidence inventory ahead of the evidence session? We’ll pre-stage any docs we have.

— Jamie
Security Program Manager, Skyline Health
j.torres@skylinehealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-01T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Skyline Health — compliance architecture deep-dive & evidence timeline

Jamie — thanks. Splitting makes sense. A few quick notes so the sessions are productive: 

- Architecture + SSO (we’ll cover SAML metadata exchange, assertion attributes, and a short demo of SSO provisioning) — please tell us which IdP you use (Okta/AzureAD/Auth0).
- Evidence session (we’ll map items to SOC 2 criteria and mark where Redwood holds evidence vs where Skyline must provide logs/config)

I’ve attached:
- redwood_arch_diagram.png (high-level infra + control plane separation)
- evidence_inventory_v1.xlsx (pre-filled template; add rows and share back)

Suggested session times (PST):
- Architecture + SSO: Tue 10/05 10:30–11:30 — confirm if that’s still good for you.
- Evidence mapping: Wed 10/06 15:00–15:45 — we’ll keep it tight.

If Chris (security engineer) can do Wed afternoon that would be ideal.

Cheers,
Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
[Attachment: evidence_inventory_v1.xlsx]

Quick update: Chris Bell (security engineer) is available Wed 10/06 but only after 16:00 PST. We’d like to propose moving the evidence session to Thu 10/07 09:00–09:45 PST or Thu 10/07 14:00–14:45 PST instead. Either works for us.

- If possible, upload any existing SOC 2 artifacts you already have to the Drive folder (link below). We’ll pre-populate our side of the mapping sheet.

All —

- Evidence mapping (SOC 2): Thu 10/07 14:00–14:45 PST

Agenda (arch + SSO):
1) Quick intro & scope (5m)
2) High-level infra & isolation model (15m)
3) SSO integration walk-through + metadata exchange (20m)
